data.title: Mobile contract confirmation – Beispielnetz Smart 20 GB
data.summary: Beispielnetz Mobil GmbH confirms Anton Musterschmidt's new mobile contract (tariff "Beispielnetz Smart 20 GB"), activated on 24 January 2026, with a 12-month minimum term and a monthly base price of €17.99.
data.explanation: This is a welcome/confirmation letter for the mobile phone contract you just ordered. There is nothing urgent to do now: the SIM activates automatically and the first (pro-rated) invoice will follow. Note the minimum term of 12 months from activation and that cancellation afterwards needs 1 month's notice, which you can give in text form or via the cancellation button in your online account. Keep this letter for your records in case you need the exact term or notice details later.
